android.permission.CAMERA.explanation: Camera access can capture images and video when granted and used.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.explanation: Microphone access can capture audio when granted and used.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.explanation: Fine location permission can provide precise device location.

android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.explanation: Background location permission can allow location access while the app is not in use.

android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.explanation: Coarse location permission can provide approximate device location.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.explanation: Contacts permission can expose address-book information.

android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.explanation: Contacts permission can modify address-book information.

android.permission.READ_SMS.explanation: SMS permission can expose message contents and verification codes.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.explanation: SMS permission can send messages that may incur charges or disclose information.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.explanation: Call log permission can expose call history and associated numbers.

android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.explanation: Phone state access can reveal telephony and call state information.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.explanation: Legacy shared storage permission can expose files outside app-specific storage.

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.explanation: Legacy shared storage permission can modify files outside app-specific storage.

android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.explanation: Bluetooth connect permission allows interaction with paired devices.

android.permission.INTERNET.explanation: Internet access allows network communication; it does not establish what data is transmitted.

android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.explanation: Allows keeping the processor awake for background work.

android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.explanation: Overlay access can draw windows over other apps and affect user interaction.
